title: Conservation Mascot
description: Wearing a costume of the near-threatened Eurasian curlew, conservationist Matt Trevelyan opens a gate on a farm as he strolls through the Nidderdale valley in northern England. Photographer and National Geographic Explorer Morgan Heim took this image of Trevelyan, who in recent years has worn his handcrafted getup on a 53-mile hike—and even to London’s Parliament—to raise awareness about the bird’s vanishing habitat in the English moors.
translated_description: 环保主义者马特·特里维廉穿着近危物种白腰杓鹬的服装，漫步穿过英格兰北部的尼德代尔山谷时，打开了一个农场的门。摄影师兼《国家地理》探险家摩根·海姆拍摄了特里维廉的这张照片。近年来，特里维廉穿着他手工制作的这套服装，完成了53英里的徒步旅行——甚至穿到了伦敦议会——以提高人们对这种鸟类在英格兰沼泽地逐渐消失的栖息地的认识。
